WorktreePreview.mjs:78 says `merged()` runs "the same three tests the clean-up uses", but it doesn't. It checks ancestor, empty `base...HEAD` diff and `.merge-landed.json`, while Server/Worktrees.mjs uses `Pool.landed()` (which includes a file-content test) and Servex/Worktrees.js has its own `merged()`. That makes three "is it merged?" checks (law 6). A branch whose content landed without its commits is kept until the 48-hour backstop. Reusing `Pool.landed()` would remove this and make the comment true.

Servex/Worktrees.js `serve_previews()`: `this.lan` lives only in memory. After a Servex restart, a server adopted on 0.0.0.0 whose branch merged while Servex was down is in neither `before` nor `want`, so it stays on the LAN until its folder is removed. This is small, because removal follows soon after.

Requirement 4 says "the landing line carries the link". What was built is a separate computed `preview:` line that on-landing.mjs appends after the landing, plus the card link. That fits the "computed, not typed" rule, but the link is not inside the landing outcome itself.

assign.title: servex: a worktree waiting for review stays up and opens on the phone (build F, not merged)
assign.outcome: Built on branch worktree/worktree-preview (5 commits, head adeb55cf5: 673e866bc, f3850a29e, 1dfc25c09, e9e9a6be3, adeb55cf5), NOT merged, as the brief said. What it does: when a task lands with its branch unmerged, its worktree is kept until the merge (48 quiet hours is the backstop; pool slots qf-* still recycle). A task that logs {"assign":{"preview":true}} (or a path like "/framework/ai/") also gets its dev server bound to 0.0.0.0, kept running (never stopped as idle or reaped), and a link http://<LAN IP>:<port>/ worked out from ports.json and the PC's private IPv4: shown as 'Try it on your phone' on the ready-to-merge card and as a `preview:` line on-landing.mjs writes. Back to loopback once merged. The LAN socket stays push-only. Tests: node Server/WorktreePreview.test.mjs (38 checks, scratch repo in the OS temp folder, Servex port 9, nothing real touched; a mutation removing the hold fails it); existing suites pass: ReadyToMerge.test 32, Worktrees.test, pool-hold, processes 38, Pool, pool-heal, pool-restore, Landed-merged. Not run end to end: on-landing.mjs as a whole (it spawns paid reviewers), and a real phone opening a real worktree. Review: reviewed: 2 fixed, 5 noted; merge gate ok (needs --review-dir, since this task sits outside ai/sessions/). RESTART NOTE for the owner: none of this is live until the branch is merged into michael/dev and then Servex is restarted with `node Servex/sustain.mjs --restart` (refuses while agents work; never during a voice call, it drops the call). Server/ scripts (on-landing.mjs, Worktrees.mjs, ReadyToMerge.mjs) take effect at merge with no restart; Servex/Worktrees.js, Servex.js and Lifecycle.js need the restart. To use it: a task logs {"assign":{"preview":true}} before landing.
